# cloudtower_vds (Data Source)

CloudTower vds data source.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) filter vdses by cluster id.
- `cluster_id_in` (List of String) filter vdses by cluster id in list.
- `name` (String) filter vdses by name.
- `name_contains` (String) filter vdses by name contains.
- `name_in` (List of String) filter vdses by name in list.
- `type` (String) filter vdses by type. Must be one of: ACCESS, MANAGEMENT, MIGRATION, STORAGE, VM.
- `type_in` (List of String) filter vdses by type in list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vds` (List of Object) list of vds (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vds))
